Welcome Edition — v1.0

Hi, welcome in.

If you're reading this, you've probably tried the normal productivity systems — GTD, the bullet journal, the 5am wake-up — the ones written for brains that don't need to be tricked into starting. And somewhere along the way, you concluded the problem was you. It wasn't.

The promise: use even one piece of this system for two weeks — the daily focus sheet, one task breakdown, one body doubling session — and you'll get more done than in your last month of "trying harder." That's the dopamine mechanics, not hype.

Your first 15 minutes

1
Print two things. The reference card and one daily focus sheet. Tape the card by your screen. Three minutes, changes the week.
2
Follow the quick-start guide. Build the skeleton first — don't customize yet.
3
Add three real tasks to Today in your dashboard. Pick the hardest — that's your first focus sprint tomorrow.
4
Schedule one body doubling session this week. Even one. The guide includes ready-to-send invites.

Questions, a stuck setup step, a "where does this go" moment — support@dopakit.com, a real human replies within 24 hours.
